Knowledge center/Policies

Cookie and browser storage notice

The only cookies and browser storage neon1.tech and 1NEON use, and why.

Type
Policy
First written
November 6, 2026
Updated
November 7, 2026
Download PDF View source

Last updated November 7, 2026.

Neither neon1.tech nor the 1NEON portal uses analytics, advertising, or tracking of any kind.

neon1.tech

The website sets no cookies. Your browser saves two small things, on your device only:

Saved itemWhat it's forHow long it lasts
neon1.rain (local storage)The rain settings you pick: grid or free, the characters, and pauseUntil you clear it
neon1.handoff (session storage)Lets the portal fade in when you open it from the websiteRemoved as soon as the portal opens

The 1NEON portal

The portal uses only the cookies it needs to sign you in and keep you signed in:

CookieWhat it's forHow long it lasts
__Secure-1neon_atKeeps you signed in (access token)15 minutes
__Secure-1neon_rtRenews your sign-in without asking againUp to 30 days, or until you sign out. Without "remember me", until you close the browser
__Secure-1neon_stepHolds a sign-in in progress between steps5 minutes
__Secure-1neon_rmRemembers your "remember me" choice during sign-in5 minutes
__Secure-1neon_flowProtects sign-in with Google10 minutes
Sign-in service cookies on auth.neon1.techProtect the sign-in step (Amazon Cognito)Your sign-in session

These cookies are strictly necessary, can only be read by the portal's own server, are never used for advertising or analytics, and are never shared. Because of that, the portal doesn't show a cookie consent banner. If you block them, you won't be able to sign in.

The portal also saves, on your device only:

Saved itemWhat it's forHow long it lasts
1neon.last (local storage)Whether you were last signed in, so a reload starts on the right backgroundUntil you clear it
1neon.signin (session storage)Your email and the sign-in step in progress, so a reload mid sign-in returns to the code step. The code itself is never saved5 minutes, or until the tab closes
neon1.rain (local storage)The same rain settings as the website, on the sign-in screenUntil you clear it

Your other preferences, such as your theme, are saved with your account.

If I ever add optional cookies or storage, such as analytics, I'll update this notice and ask for your consent first.
